platform_recipes.civicplus: /calendar.aspx?view=list&year=YYYY&month=M gives every event for a month as HTML (h3 title + div.date); /RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml gives roughly the next two weeks with calendarEvent:EventDates/EventTimes/Location. Towns: Paramus, Ridgewood, Fort Lee, Englewood, Mahwah, Westwood, Ramsey, Tenafly, Oradell, Oakland, Ho-Ho-Kus, Edgewater, East Rutherford, Moonachie, Ridgefield Park, Upper Saddle River, Wallington, Midland Park (Wyckoff is CivicPlus's Drupal product: /calendar/month).
platform_recipes.joomla-dpcalendar: /resident/calendar is JS; read /index.php?option=com_dpcalendar&task=ical.download&id=N for each calendar id linked on the page (plain iCal, local times). Towns: Rutherford, Glen Rock, Park Ridge, Woodcliff Lake, Harrington Park, Fairview, Old Tappan, Cresskill, Demarest, Teterboro.
platform_recipes.govstack: events.<town> or calendar.<town>: /default/Month?StartDate=MM/01/YYYY; event links are /default/Detail/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-Title. Towns: Teaneck, Allendale, Montvale.
platform_recipes.custom-json-api: /api/data/GetCalendarEvents?start=MM/DD/YYYY 12:00 am&end=MM/DD/YYYY 12:00 am returns FullCalendar JSON (title, start, end). Towns: Garfield, Lyndhurst, North Arlington, Carlstadt, Wood-Ridge.
platform_recipes.wordpress: Hackensack and Bergenfield expose /wp-json/wp/v2/event; sites using The Events Calendar expose /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?start_date=YYYY-MM-DD&per_page=50 (Kaplen JCC, YWCA Northern NJ, Edgewater library, Rohsler's, Downtown Hackensack); Bergen County uses Modern Events Calendar with an RSS feed at /events/feed/.
platform_recipes.libcal: https://bccls.libcal.com/ajax/calendar/list?c=<cid>&date=0000-00-00&perpage=48&page=N returns JSON for any BCCLS library; ids are in library_calendar_table.
platform_recipes.squarespace: Append ?format=json to an events collection URL; 'upcoming' holds events with startDate in epoch milliseconds (Ridgewood Historical Society).
platform_recipes.apptegy-thrillshare: Closter, Norwood and River Vale sit behind a bot challenge on their own domains; use Firecrawl, the <org>.sites.thrillshare.com mirror, or the generate_ical endpoint.
platform_recipes.js-only (govoffice-catalis, evogov, revi: Calendar grids load by JavaScript and returned nothing to a plain fetch: Hillsdale, Emerson, Haworth, Saddle River, River Edge, Rochelle Park, Waldwick, Cliffside Park, Englewood Cliffs, Dumont, New Milford, Washington Township, Alpine, Bogota, Northvale, Lodi. They need a rendering scraper. Exceptions on GovOffice that are readable as text: Maywood /news-events and Franklin Lakes /communityevents.
platform_recipes.community-pass / recdesk / daysmart: Recreation registration portals. Community Pass (register.capturepoint.com / register.communitypass.net) is used by Ridgewood, Fair Lawn, Lodi, Wyckoff, Montvale, Elmwood Park, River Vale and Park Ridge and needs a login, except Park Ridge's public calendar at /reg/pubcal.cfm?a=1176. RecDesk (Hackensack, Lyndhurst) shows its program list publicly. Teaneck uses DaySmart Recreation (login).

flags: Bergen County Winter Wonderland: the official site said 'RETURNING FRIDAY, November 27, 2026' on Nov 12, 2026; holidays-2026.json has the opening as Nov 20, 2026.
hasbrouckheights.org now redirects to a parked '/lander' page; the borough site that loads is hasbrouck-heights.nj.us.

Several old town domains have moved: paramusborough.org to paramusborough.gov, tenaflynj.org to tenaflynj.gov, wyckoff-nj.com to wyckoffnj.gov, bogotaonline.org to bogotanj.gov, newmilfordboro.com to newmilfordnj.gov, northvalenj.org to boroughofnorthvale.com, njwoodridge.org to woodridgenj.gov, closternj.us to closterboro.com, ho-ho-kusboro.com to hhkborough.com, oakland-nj.org to oakland-nj.gov, saddleriver.org to saddleriver.gov; alpinenj.org, demarestnj.org and saddlebrooknj.gov are dead (use alpinenj.gov, demarestnj.gov, saddlebrooknj.us).
Hulafrog no longer exists as a separate site: hulafrog.com/ridgewood-paramus-nj lands on a Macaroni KID 404 page.
gaps: Facebook groups: search engines surfaced names only (a 'Bergen County Moms' group started by a Westwood mom in 2013, 'Ridgewood Moms', and The Bergen Girl's 'North Jersey Locals' group) but no facebook.com/groups URLs or member counts, so none are listed as sources. They need a logged-in session to find and read.
American Dream: americandream.com/events returned a JS shell to plain fetch and a 'can't find what you're looking for' page to Firecrawl; no working events URL found.

Town recreation departments mostly announce through Community Pass (login), emailed flyers and Facebook; for Paramus, Englewood, Fair Lawn, Garfield, Lodi, Ramsey, Tenafly and Montvale the web calendar had no public events at all.
16 town calendars are JavaScript-only and were not read (see platform_recipes); Palisades Park's site was down (503).
